node.statement: The relation is symmetric: def-compressed-corner gives C_{P,Q}(Z)^dagger=C_{Q,P}(Z^dagger), so the conjugate-linear involution dagger restricts to a bijection S_{P,Q}->S_{Q,P}; consequently these complex vector spaces have equal dimension, and dim S_{P_j,P_k}=1 implies dim S_{P_k,P_j}=1.
